commands.cmd: p=$(command -v zizmor) && echo "resolves: $p -> $(readlink -f "$p")" && python3 -c "import json,glob,sys;c=sys.argv[1];print('stack',[x['version'] for x in json.load(open('manifests/stack.json'))['components'] if x['id']==c],'winner pins',sorted({w['pin'] for f in glob.glob('catalogs/landscape/*.json') for l in json.load(open(f)).get('layers',[]) for w in (l.get('winners') or []) if w.get('component_id')==c}))" zizmor

Z="$HOME/.local/share/codex-ecosystem/tools/zizmor-1.30.1"; out=$(uv pip sync --dry-run --offline --python "$Z/bin/python" .github/requirements-ci.txt 2>&1) && printf '%s\n' "$out" | tail -2 && printf '%s' "$out" | grep -q 'Would make no changes' && python3 -c "import base64,hashlib,sys;z=sys.argv[1];rec=[l.strip().split(',') for l in open(z+'/lib/python3.13/site-packages/zizmor-1.30.1.dist-info/RECORD') if l.startswith('../../../bin/zizmor,')][0];h='sha256='+base64.urlsafe_b64encode(hashlib.sha256(open(z+'/bin/zizmor','rb').read()).digest()).rstrip(b'=').decode();print('venv matches the hash-pinned .github/requirements-ci.txt (zizmor==1.30.1) | installed bin/zizmor equals its wheel RECORD entry:',h==rec[1],'size',rec[2]);raise SystemExit(0 if h==rec[1] else 1)" "$Z"
